rules.derivation: Both documents use zero-based row and column coordinates. Reading selects that element; setting replaces only that coordinate. The literal rectangular cell tables and NA float cells apply these operations directly.
Rows and columns describe independent dimensions. Empty 0x0, one-row, one-column and 2x3 literals have their explicitly declared dimensions. No non-square zero-dimension case is inferred.

A copy has a distinct matrix ID, the same original dimensions and initial elements. Replacing primitive numeric cells on either matrix does not replace cells on the other. Shared reference-type elements are expressly outside these cases.
A var declaration retains its matrix ID across bars until reassignment; the cases use ordinary var and do not claim varip collection behavior.
